title.zh: Datavault AI称未能从Biconomy提取比特币，股价暴跌近50%
title.en: Datavault AI称未能从Biconomy提取比特币，股价暴跌近50%

current_state.zh: Datavault AI 确认约1,328 BTC仍无法从Biconomy钱包提取，拟将相关款项重分类为股权发行应收认购款并重述财报，同时重新评估持续经营能力；股价10月27日收跌49.6%至约0.067美元。
current_state.en: Datavault AI confirms about 1,328 BTC remain unavailable for withdrawal from its Biconomy wallet; it plans to reclassify the proceeds as an equity subscription receivable, restate affected financials, and reassess going-concern status, while its stock closed down 49.6% at about $0.067 on October 27.

updates.title_zh: Datavault AI称未能从Biconomy提取比特币，股价暴跌近50%
updates.title_en: Datavault AI称未能从Biconomy提取比特币，股价暴跌近50%
updates.what_changed_zh: Datavault AI 在 10 月 26 日的 8-K 文件中披露，其 Biconomy 账户中的比特币自 6 月提出请求以来一直无法提取，导致其股价下跌近 50%；这些比特币来自 Scilex Holding 于 2025 年 9 月以比特币计价进行的 1.5 亿美元股份认购。
updates.what_changed_en: Datavault AI disclosed in an October 26 8-K that bitcoin held in its Biconomy account has not been withdrawable since a June request, sending its shares down nearly 50%; the coins originated from a $150M bitcoin-denominated share subscription by Scilex Holding in September 2025.

updates.title_zh: 【Datavault AI 披露 1.5 亿美元比特币提现受阻，股价收跌 49.6%】
updates.title_en: 【Datavault AI 披露 1.5 亿美元比特币提现受阻，股价收跌 49.6%】
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：相关比特币约1,328.43枚；Datavault AI 10月27日收跌49.6%至约0.067美元；公司拟将款项改记为股权发行应收认购款并作为股东权益减项，计划重述受影响财报，同时重新评估持续经营能力，重述时间未定。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: about 1,328.43 BTC are involved; Datavault AI closed down 49.6% at about $0.067 on October 27; the company plans to reclassify the proceeds as an equity subscription receivable and a deduction from shareholders' equity, restate affected financials, and reassess going-concern status, with restatement timing undetermined.
updates.current_state_zh: Datavault AI 确认约1,328 BTC仍无法从Biconomy钱包提取，拟将相关款项重分类为股权发行应收认购款并重述财报，同时重新评估持续经营能力；股价10月27日收跌49.6%至约0.067美元。
updates.current_state_en: Datavault AI confirms about 1,328 BTC remain unavailable for withdrawal from its Biconomy wallet; it plans to reclassify the proceeds as an equity subscription receivable, restate affected financials, and reassess going-concern status, while its stock closed down 49.6% at about $0.067 on October 27.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Datavault AI disclosed that roughly 1,328 BTC (~$150M) tied to a Scilex equity transaction cannot be withdrawn from a third-party Biconomy wallet, sending its stock down 49.6% as it reclassifies the proceeds, plans to restate financials, and reassesses going-concern status.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Datavault AI disclosed that roughly 1,328 BTC (~$150M) tied to a Scilex equity transaction cannot be withdrawn from a third-party Biconomy wallet, sending its stock down 49.6% as it reclassifies the proceeds, plans to restate financials, and reassesses going-concern status.
